run_social_posts_cli: run the generate_social_posts CLI to create draft social media posts for a release version
generate_social_drafts: generate social media drafts from release notes using OpenCode with the hf-release-notes:social skill
validate_social_outputs: validate that all expected social media draft files were produced and are non-empty
run_opencode_skill: run the OpenCode skill to generate LinkedIn and X social media posts from release notes
summarize_social_drafts: summarize generated social media draft files with file size and content preview
